team.collaboration: Collaborate only within the team under contest rules.

execution.turn_budget_basis: official clock n/a turns vs floor 35 (15 teammates x 2 turns + 1 answer parts + 4 for synthesis)

human_constraints: You must behave like a human teammate under official contest rules.
Do not claim tools, internet, or materials that the rule card forbids.
Do not look up answer keys or hidden solutions.
Follow the free sample-event packet constraints.
Use only allowed references listed for the event; many official manuals are membership-locked.
No unrestricted web search unless the event rules explicitly allow it.
National organization site; Divisions B/C teams capped at 15 students (standard national rule; exact wording in membership Rules Manual).
Event-specific rules manuals are membership-locked — free sample exams only in this repo’s collection strategy.
Many events allow specified binders/tools; others are build/lab — per-event PDFs required.

agent_roles.name: Agent_1
agent_roles.title: captain
duties: Direct who answers and stop teammates from talking over each other.
Give the team's official answer once the group has settled.
Submit only after the format and rule checks pass.

agent_roles.name: Agent_2
agent_roles.title: primary solver
duties: Produce the first full attempt at the problem.
Show the reasoning so a teammate can check it.

agent_roles.name: Agent_3
agent_roles.title: secondary solver
duties: Attack the problem from a different angle than the primary solver.
Compare results and surface the disagreement early.

agent_roles.name: Agent_4
agent_roles.title: verifier
duties: Challenge weak arguments and demand an independent check.
Reject an answer rather than let an unverified one be submitted.

agent_roles.name: Agent_5
agent_roles.title: specialist
duties: Take the part of the task that matches your stated specialty.
Check a teammate's work once your own part is done.

agent_roles.name: Agent_6
agent_roles.title: scribe
duties: Keep the shared workspace readable and current.
Write answers in the required format as they are settled.

agent_roles.name: Agent_7
agent_roles.title: researcher
duties: Find and cite the authorities the argument depends on.
Bring counter-authority to the team before a judge does.

agent_roles.name: Agent_8
agent_roles.title: specialist and completeness checker
duties: Scan for unanswered problems before the team submits.
Confirm every required part of the deliverable is present.

answer_format: Submit the team's final answers in numbered order, using exact values when required.
rules_text: Science Olympiad (USA). The team of 15 splits into event pairs; this row is one event packet worked with the materials that event permits. Collaborate only within the team under contest rules. The team files one shared submission. Official wall-clock timing is not encoded for this track; treat the turn budget as your clock and submit before it runs out. Simulation note: the hands-on portion is represented in text, so state measurements, setup, and reasoning explicitly instead of demonstrating them.

adaptations: max_turns is a safety budget, not necessarily the official wall-clock limit
specialist roles are a research roster overlay
physical/oral/live opponent fidelity may be incomplete in src/

crawled_excerpts.excerpt: Science Olympiad national team STEM competition with event-specific rule PDFs. Follow event references and code of ethics. Sample-packet coverage is incomplete; proxy where physical events are unavailable.

proxy_limitations: Without the locked Rules Manual, event-level tool lists cannot be asserted.
